item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00015","case1_error":"Drops parentheses in the profit-per-mile expression and gives unsupported $100; the correctly stated earnings-minus-gas formula yields $180.","case2_error":"Multiplies combined weekday and Saturday earnings by five, counting Saturday earnings five times; weekly earnings should be $400.","reason":"Case 1 has a grouping error and unsupported final number; case 2 incorrectly repeats a once-weekly payment.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00016","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for the reduced usable length of purchased rope.","case2_error":"Includes only one three-second elevator stop despite stops on every floor, incorrectly identifying Lola as slower.","reason":"Case 1 applies the loss to the wrong quantity; case 2 omits repeated stop durations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00017","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds instead of the specified two.","case2_error":"Equates one-sixth of a day with 24 hours, ignoring the one-sixth factor; it should be four hours.","reason":"Exceeding the specified iteration count differs from omitting a fractional factor in time conversion.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00018","case1_error":"Reports five inches per constituent piece rather than fifteen inches per tied assembly, although 'pieces' leaves the requested referent ambiguous.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 960 after correctly writing 120 + (6 × 120), which yields 840.","reason":"Case 1 has a materially ambiguous component-versus-assembly interpretation. Case 2 clearly supplies an incorrect final number after a correct formula.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00019","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"The answer marker and concluding sentence say 26, contradicting the correct derivation of 14.","reason":"Case 1 is an explicit arithmetic evaluation error; case 2 is an answer conflict with an otherwise correct derivation.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
